fields.title: Task Intake
fields.description: Create and submit new tasks for projects.
fields.content:
## Task Intake

Create new tasks and assign them to projects.

### Creating a Task
1. Enter task title
2. Write a description (JSON format for executable tasks)
3. Assign to a project and phase
4. Set priority
5. Submit

### Executable Task Format
Tasks for Claude execution must include:
- **objective** - What the task should accomplish
- **inputs** - Required context
- **actions** - Step-by-step instructions
- **output** - Expected deliverable

fields.title: Cycle Tracking Home
fields.description: Track your menstrual cycle, log daily symptoms, and view predictions.
fields.content:
## Cycle Tracking

Track your menstrual cycle to understand your body's patterns.

### What You'll See
- **Current phase** - Which phase you're in (Menstrual, Follicular, Ovulation, Luteal)
- **Days until period** - Predicted countdown
- **Recent logs** - Your latest daily entries
- **Quick stats** - Cycle length, regularity score

### Daily Logging
Log each day's data:
- **Flow level** - None, Spotting, Light, Medium, Heavy
- **Symptoms** - Cramps, headache, fatigue, bloating, etc.
- **Mood** - How you're feeling emotionally
- **Energy level** - Rate 1-5
- **Fertility data** - Cervical mucus, basal temp (optional)

### Predictions
After 3+ completed cycles, the system predicts:
- Next period start date
- Fertile window (if enabled)
- Confidence score based on your regularity

### Privacy
Cycle tracking is opt-in and your data is private. Enable or disable anytime in Preferences.

---

## Related Features
- **Cycle Calendar** - Visual month view of your cycle
- **Cycle Settings** - Customize tracking preferences
- **Health Insights** - Cycle-aware pattern analysis
- **Dashboard** - Current phase displayed if enabled

fields.title: Cycle Calendar
fields.description: View your menstrual cycle data on a calendar with phase colors and daily details.
fields.content:
## Cycle Calendar

A visual month view of your cycle data.

### How to Read the Calendar
- **Red days** - Menstrual phase (period)
- **Orange days** - Follicular phase
- **Green days** - Ovulation window
- **Blue days** - Luteal phase
- **Dots/icons** - Days with logged symptoms

### Interacting
- Click any day to view or edit that day's log
- Navigate months with the arrows
- Predicted period days are shown with lighter shading

### What It Shows
- Flow levels for each day
- Symptom indicators
- Phase boundaries
- Predicted dates (dashed outlines)

### Tips
- Log daily for the most accurate calendar view
- Compare months side-by-side to spot patterns
- Use with the stats page for deeper analysis

fields.title: Cycle Tracking Settings
fields.description: Customize your cycle tracking preferences and notification settings.
fields.content:
## Cycle Settings

Customize how cycle tracking works for you.

### Available Settings
- **Enable/Disable** - Turn cycle tracking on or off
- **Default cycle length** - Your typical cycle length (used for initial predictions)
- **Default period length** - Your typical period length
- **Fertility tracking** - Enable fertile window predictions
- **Notifications** - Get reminders about upcoming periods

### Privacy Controls

- You can export your cycle data separately
- Disabling cycle tracking hides the feature but preserves your data

### Tips
- Set your default cycle length based on your best estimate
- After 3 cycles, the system uses your actual data for predictions
- Enable fertility tracking only if useful to you

fields.title: Insights Inbox
fields.content:
The Insights Inbox shows AI-generated insights about your data patterns. Your AI assistant analyzes your health trends, goal progress, habit streaks, scripture reading, and journaling patterns to provide timely, actionable observations.

**How it works:**
- Insights are generated automatically when you log data and during daily scheduled checks
- Each insight explains WHY it was generated and links to the underlying evidence
- Insights are categorized by severity: Info, Positive, Warning, and Critical

**Managing insights:**
- **New** insights appear with a badge and full opacity
- Click **Mark Read** to acknowledge an insight
- Click **Dismiss** to remove it from your active view
- Use the filter buttons to view All, New, Read, or Dismissed insights

**Types of insights:**
- Weight trends (up or down over 14 days)
- Missing data reminders (weight, body composition)
- Goal deadline risks and stagnation warnings
- Habit streak celebrations and broken streak alerts
- Scripture reading and journaling pattern changes
- Repeated out-of-range lab results

fields.title: Today's Guidance
fields.description: Evidence-based guidance items on your dashboard.
fields.content:
## Today's Guidance

The Today's Guidance panel on your dashboard shows the most important insights, warnings, and encouragement generated by your intelligence engines.

### How Items Are Generated
Guidance items come from three sources:
- **State** — Generated from your current life data (e.g., you haven't journaled in 5 days)
- **Insight** — Triggered by patterns the AI detected (e.g., your weight is trending down)
- **Prediction** — Based on projected trends (e.g., you may miss a goal deadline)
- **Guidance** — Composite items combining multiple signals

### What Each Action Does
- **I did it** (checkmark) — Marks the item as acted upon. Use this when you've taken the suggested action.
- **Snooze** (zzz) — Hides the item for 24 hours. It will reappear after that.
- **Dismiss** (X) — Permanently removes the item from your active list.

### Confidence Scores
Some items show a confidence score (e.g., "Confidence: 0.86"). This appears only for prediction-based guidance and tells you how certain the system is about the projected trend.

### View All Guidance
Click "View all guidance" at the bottom of the panel to see your complete guidance history, including dismissed and snoozed items.

### Tips
1. Items are ranked by priority — critical items appear first
2. Acting on guidance helps the system learn what's useful to you
3. Dismissing items you find unhelpful is encouraged — it keeps your dashboard clean

fields.title: Guidance Inbox
fields.description: Your complete guidance history with lifecycle filtering.
fields.content:
## Guidance Inbox

The Guidance Inbox is your complete intelligence center for all guidance generated by WLJ's AI engines. Unlike the dashboard panel (which shows only the top 5 active items), the inbox shows your full history with powerful filtering.

### Filter Tabs
Use the filter tabs at the top to view guidance by lifecycle state:
- **Active** — Items that need your attention right now
- **Acknowledged** — Items you've marked as read
- **Dismissed** — Items you've permanently dismissed
- **Snoozed** — Items temporarily hidden (will return when the snooze expires)
- **Acted** — Items you've acted upon
- **All** — Every guidance item regardless of state

### Source Badges
Each item shows a colored badge indicating where it came from:
- **State** (blue) — Based on your current life data snapshot
- **Insight** (purple) — Triggered by detected patterns in your data
- **Prediction** (amber) — Based on projected trends and trajectories
- **Composite** (green) — Combines signals from multiple engines

### Confidence Scores
Prediction-sourced items display a confidence score (e.g., 0.85) indicating how certain the AI is about the projected trend. Higher scores mean greater confidence.

### Available Actions
For active items, you can:
- **Mark Read** — Acknowledge the item without taking action
- **Acknowledge** — Similar to marking read, signals awareness
- **I Did It** — Mark the suggested action as completed
- **Snooze 24h** — Hide the item for 24 hours
- **Dismiss** — Permanently remove from your active queue

### Priority Levels
Items are color-coded by priority (1 = highest, 5 = lowest). Critical items appear first and have a red accent bar.

### Tips
1. Check your inbox regularly to stay on top of AI-generated guidance
2. Use the Acted filter to review what you've accomplished
3. Dismissed items are never lost — you can always review them via the Dismissed filter
4. The count badges on each tab help you see at a glance where items are in their lifecycle

fields.title: Your Current State
fields.description: What WLJ knows about you right now.
fields.content:
## Your Current State

The "Your Current State" panel on your dashboard shows the key data points that WLJ's intelligence engines use to generate insights, predictions, and guidance.

### What Is State?
State is a real-time snapshot of your life data — your current weight, sleep patterns, goal progress, habit streaks, journaling frequency, and scripture reading. This is the foundation that powers all of WLJ's AI features.

### How Is It Used?
Every time WLJ generates an insight, prediction, or guidance item, it reads from your state snapshot. For example:
- If your weight trend shows "↓ improving," the AI knows you're making progress
- If your journal shows "5 days ago," the AI might nudge you to write
- If a goal deadline is approaching, the AI can warn you

### Why Does It Matter?
Transparency builds trust. By showing you exactly what WLJ knows, you can:
1. **Verify accuracy** — Confirm the data matches your expectations
2. **Understand guidance** — See why the AI made a specific recommendation
3. **Spot gaps** — Notice if you haven't logged data recently

### Displayed Sections
- **Health** — Current weight, weight trend, average sleep and steps (7-day)
- **Goals** — Active goals, overdue count, next deadline
- **Habits** — Active habits, longest streak, average completion rate
- **Journal** — Last entry date, entries in the last 30 days
- **Faith** — Reading streak, last scripture reading

Sections only appear when you have data in that area. Start logging activity to build your state profile.

fields.title: Daily Briefing
fields.description: Your daily intelligence summary.
fields.content:
## Daily Briefing

The Daily Briefing is a concise intelligence summary generated each morning. It tells you the most important things WLJ's AI engines have detected about your life data.

### What Is It?
The Daily Briefing aggregates intelligence from four engines:
- **State Awareness Engine (SAE)** — Your current data snapshot
- **Proactive Insight Engine (PIE)** — Detected patterns and trends
- **Predictive Intelligence Engine (PRIE)** — Projected trajectories
- **Proactive Guidance Engine (PGE)** — Actionable recommendations

It does not generate new intelligence — it summarizes and prioritizes what already exists.

### How Are Items Selected?
The briefing includes up to 5 items, prioritized by:
1. Critical guidance (highest priority)
2. High-confidence predictions
3. Warning or critical insights
4. Remaining guidance items
5. State changes and informational insights

### When Is It Generated?
Briefings are generated once per day, typically in the morning. If you visit your dashboard before the briefing runs, you'll see a message that it hasn't been generated yet.

### Why Does It Matter?
Instead of checking multiple panels, the Daily Briefing gives you a quick summary of what matters most — so you can start your day informed and focused.

fields.title: Weekly Intelligence Reports
fields.description: Your weekly intelligence summary.
fields.content:
## Weekly Intelligence Reports

Weekly Intelligence Reports provide a comprehensive summary of your intelligence data from the past week. They help you track your progress and identify trends over time.

### What Is Included?
- **State Changes** — Notable changes in your health, goals, habits, journal activity, and faith.
- **Key Insights** — The most important patterns detected by the Proactive Insight Engine (PIE).
- **Predictions** — Trajectory projections from the Predictive Intelligence Engine (PRIE).
- **Guidance Engagement** — How you interacted with guidance items (acknowledged, acted upon, dismissed).
- **Learning Profile** — Your responsiveness score reflecting how actively you engage with guidance.

### When Are They Generated?
Weekly reports are generated once per week, covering Monday through Sunday. The Intelligence Scheduler Engine (ISE) handles this automatically.

### Where Can I View Them?
The most recent report appears as a tile on your dashboard. You can also view all historical reports at Intelligence → Weekly Reports.

fields.title: Evidence & Explainability
fields.description: See exactly why a piece of intelligence was generated
fields.content:
The Evidence & Explainability page shows you exactly why a piece of intelligence was generated. You will see:

- **Explanation**: A human-readable description of why this was generated, including which rules and data sources were used.
- **Confidence Assessment**: For predictive guidance, an explanation of the confidence score.
- **Supporting Evidence**: A list of specific data points that contributed to the recommendation, with links to the source data when available.

Every guidance card, daily briefing, and weekly report has a "Why?" link that takes you here.

fields.title: Intelligence Delivery Settings
fields.description: Control how and when WLJ delivers intelligence notifications
fields.content:
## Intelligence Delivery Settings

Control how and when WLJ delivers intelligence notifications to you.

### Delivery Channels
Currently, intelligence is delivered via the in-app notification bell. Future channels (email, push notifications) can be enabled here as they become available.

### Quiet Hours
Set a daily quiet window during which no notifications will be delivered. Notifications generated during quiet hours are held and delivered when the window ends. This is useful for avoiding interruptions during sleep or focused work.

### Rate Limits
Configure how many notifications you receive per hour and per day. When the limit is reached, lower-priority notifications are queued until the next period. Critical notifications are never suppressed.

### Notification Types
You can enable or disable delivery for specific intelligence types:
- **Guidance** — Actionable recommendations from the Proactive Guidance Engine
- **Daily Briefings** — Morning intelligence summaries
- **Weekly Reports** — Weekly intelligence summaries
- **Insights** — Pattern and trend detections
- **Predictions** — Trajectory projections

fields.title: Intelligence Delivery History
fields.description: View audit log of all intelligence notifications delivered to you
fields.content:
## Intelligence Delivery History

The Delivery History page shows a complete audit log of all intelligence notifications delivered to you.

### What You Can See
- **Notification type** — Whether it was guidance, a briefing, a report, an insight, or a prediction
- **Delivery status** — Whether the notification was delivered, queued, suppressed by quiet hours, or rate-limited
- **Timestamps** — When the notification was created and when it was actually delivered
- **Content preview** — A summary of the notification content with a link to the full item

### Filtering
You can filter the history by notification type, delivery status, and date range to find specific deliveries.

### Why It Matters
The delivery history provides transparency into how the intelligence system communicates with you. If you feel you are missing notifications, check here to see if they were suppressed by quiet hours or rate limits, and adjust your settings accordingly.

fields.title: Intelligence Command Center
fields.description: Your unified intelligence overview.
fields.content:
## Intelligence Command Center

This is where all WLJ intelligence is unified into a single view.

### What You'll See

- **Current State** — Your SAE snapshot showing the latest status of each life module
- **Active Guidance** — Proactive recommendations from the Guidance Engine based on your data
- **Daily Briefing** — Today's intelligence summary generated each morning
- **Weekly Report** — Longitudinal trends and progress from the past week
- **Recent Deliveries** — History of intelligence notifications sent to you
- **Predictions** — Forward-looking projections based on your data patterns

### Explainability

Every intelligence item includes a "Why?" link that explains how it was generated and what evidence supports it.

### Navigation

Use the Intelligence menu in the navigation bar to access the Command Center, Guidance inbox, Insights, Weekly Reports, and Delivery Settings.

### Getting Started

The more you use WLJ, the richer your intelligence becomes. Log journal entries, track health data, set goals, and the engines will generate increasingly personalized intelligence.

fields.title: Intelligence Observability Dashboard
fields.description: Staff-only system-wide intelligence metrics and trends.
fields.content:
## Intelligence Observability Dashboard

The Observability Dashboard provides staff administrators with a comprehensive view of how the intelligence system is performing across all users.

### Metric Tiles

**Guidance Effectiveness**
- Total guidance items generated
- Acceptance rate (acknowledged / total)
- Action rate (acted upon / total)
- Average response time

**Prediction Confidence & Coverage**
- Total predictions generated
- Active vs expired predictions
- Average confidence score

**Delivery Performance**
- Total deliveries attempted
- Success rate (sent / total)
- Breakdown by channel (in-app, email, SMS, push)
- Failed and skipped counts

**User Engagement**
- Active users count
- Average responsiveness score

**System Quality**
- Average usefulness score from quality metrics
- Total items suppressed by quality gates

**Persona Effectiveness**
- Action and dismiss rates grouped by coaching style
- Shows which persona styles drive the most user engagement

### 7-Day Trends

Each key metric shows a trend arrow comparing the latest snapshot to the 7-day average:
- ↑ (green) — Metric is improving
- ↓ (red) — Metric is declining
- → (gray) — Metric is stable

### Daily Snapshots

Metrics are aggregated once per day by the Intelligence Scheduler Engine. Each snapshot captures system-wide totals, not per-user data.

### Access

This dashboard is only visible to staff users. Regular users do not see it.

fields.title: Meal Templates: Save & Reuse Your Meals
fields.description: Create reusable meal templates from your daily nutrition log for one-tap meal logging.
fields.content:
## Meal Templates

Meal templates let you save meals you eat regularly so you can log them again with one tap.

### Creating a Template

1. Go to **Nutrition Home** and find a meal you want to save
2. Click **Save as Template** on the meal
3. Give it a name (e.g., "Monday Breakfast", "Post-Workout Shake")
4. The template saves all food items with their portions

### Using a Template

1. Go to **Meal Templates** from the Nutrition menu
2. Click **Use Template** on any saved template
3. Choose the date and meal slot to apply it to
4. All food items are logged instantly

### Managing Templates

- **Edit** — Change the template name or adjust food items and portions
- **Delete** — Remove templates you no longer use
- Templates are listed with their total calories and macro breakdown

### Tips

- Save your most common meals as templates to speed up daily logging
- You can have as many templates as you like
- Template nutrition values update if you edit the food items

fields.title: Edit Meal Template
fields.description: Modify your saved meal template name, food items, and portion sizes.
fields.content:
## Edit Meal Template

Adjust your saved meal template to keep it up to date with what you actually eat.

### What You Can Change

- **Template Name** — Rename it to something more descriptive
- **Food Items** — Add or remove individual food entries
- **Portion Sizes** — Adjust serving amounts for any item

### How to Edit

1. Go to **Meal Templates** from the Nutrition menu
2. Click the template you want to change
3. Make your edits
4. Click **Save** to update the template

### Deleting a Template

If you no longer need a template, click **Delete** on the template detail page. This does not affect any meals you previously logged using that template.

### Tips

- Update portion sizes if your serving habits change
- Templates are personal — only you can see and edit yours

fields.title: Manage Admin Guide Articles
fields.description: Create, edit, and organize supplemental admin guide articles alongside code-maintained documentation.
fields.content:
## Manage Admin Guide Articles

This page lets staff manage supplemental articles in the Admin Guide. Core documentation articles are maintained through code deployments and cannot be edited here.

### Article Types

- **Core Articles** — Locked. Maintained through code and auto-synced on deploy. Shown with a lock icon.
- **Supplemental Articles** — Editable. Created and managed from this page.

### Creating an Article

1. Click **Add Article**
2. Choose the **Section** it belongs to
3. Enter a **Title** and **Content** (Markdown supported)
4. Set the **Sort Order** to control position within the section
5. Click **Save**

### Editing & Deleting

- Click any supplemental article to edit its title, content, section, or sort order
- Click **Delete** to remove an article permanently
- Core articles cannot be edited or deleted from this interface

### Tips

- Use supplemental articles for team-specific procedures, temporary notices, or operational guides
- Core articles are the authoritative source for system documentation
